parameters.name: Pre Gain
parameters.description: Input drive into the compression envelope.

parameters.name: Attack (Lookahead)
parameters.description: Lookahead buffer time. Determines how early the limiter reacts.

parameters.name: Curve Slope
parameters.description: Blend/Slope of the attack and release curves.

parameters.name: Saturation Threshold/Type
parameters.description: Left = Type A (Hard). Right = Type B (Soft). Center = Off.

parameters.name: Saturation Ceiling
parameters.description: Threshold where saturation begins. Lower = More distortion.

parameters.name: Stereo Separation
parameters.description: Right = Mono. Left = Wide Stereo. Works per band.

parameters.name: Low Frequency Cutoff
parameters.description: Split point between Low and Mid bands.

parameters.name: High Frequency Cutoff
parameters.description: Split point between Mid and High bands.
